exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
outcome: Duration of the first stage of labor
cohort: The study cohort comprised 34 pregnant women with isthmoceles who vaginally delivered, compared to a control group of 102 pregnant women without isthmoceles who also vaginally delivered during the same period.
finding: Successful vaginal delivery is possible for women with mild and moderate isthmoceles, although the duration of the first stage of labor was significantly shorter and neonatal weight significantly lower in the isthmoceles group.
mod_finding: Successful vaginal delivery after a trial of labor (TOLAC) is possible for women with mild and moderate isthmoceles.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight was measured and found to be significantly lower in the study group.
